Subject: Intro + demo for Redwood inference — Thu Apr 8 11:00 AM PT?

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking time to talk. Per our call, we'd like to schedule a 45–60 minute demo to walk through latency/cost tradeoffs, routing policies, and the Dedicated/private deployment options most relevant for Virtuo Health.

Proposed: Thu, Apr 8, 11:00–11:45 AM PT (we can extend to 60). Soojin (SE) and I will run the walkthrough.

Agenda attached: pre-demo-agenda.pdf — high level + two short sample prompts we can run live.

If that slot doesn't work we can move or backfill with another SE — please let us know constraints (SSO, VPC, NDA, or time zones).

Thanks — looking forward.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Jonas / Claire —

Quick heads up: I just realized I have an unavoidable customer on-site visit that overlaps with the 11:00 PT slot tomorrow. I'm traveling and won't have the lab machine access needed for the live KV-cache demo. Apologies for the late flag.

Options I can offer:
- Keep 11:00 PT and Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) can backfill — Marcus ran Virtuo's proposed integration with our Dedicated runtime last quarter and can cover SSO and VPC specifics.
- Move the session by 90 minutes to 12:30 PT so I can join (but I won't get lab access until I'm at the hotel).
- Move to Friday morning (multiple slots open).

If Claire prefers to keep tomorrow's slot, I recommend Marcus as the primary backfill to avoid losing momentum. Marcus knows Virtuo's account context and the security hooks.

I attached a quick pre-demo checklist we use internally.

— Soojin
